opus.problem: Horeb and Sinai name the same mountain of God, and clues 4, 5 and 7 (the calf, God speaking out of the fire, the tablets) are told of Sinai elsewhere in the BSB. Clue 1's burning bush is also placed at Mount Sinai in Acts 7:30. A baker who answers 'Sinai' or 'Mount Sinai' would be marked wrong even though the 7 clues fit it, so the word fails 'only one thing fits it.' Either accept the Sinai forms or swap the word for a spare.
